### 2. SpotMetal Pricing Engine
- **URL**: https://apps.shopify.com/spotmetal-pricing-buyback
- **Stack**: Node.js, Redis, Real-Time Financial Websockets, Shopify Admin GraphQL
- **Key Capabilities**: Millisecond bullion & precious metal price updates (Gold, Silver, Platinum), margin rules, dynamic storefront tickers.

### 3. AutoGaragePro Platform
- **URL**: https://autogaragepro.com
- **Stack**: Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, AWS
- **Key Capabilities**: End-to-end garage operations, digital job cards, mechanic assignment, inventory parts catalog, automated invoicing.
